questions.prompt: Let \(X\) be uniformly distributed on \([0,2]\). Find \(P(0.5<X<1.5)\).
questions.answer: For a uniform continuous variable, probability is interval length divided by total length: \[P(0.5<X<1.5)=\frac{1.5-0.5}{2-0}=\frac{1}{2}.\]
The interval length is \(4-2=2\), and the total length is \(5-1=4\). Hence \[P(2<X<4)=\frac{2}{4}=0.5.\]
The favourable interval is \((7,10)\), with length \(3\). The total length is \(10\), so \[P(X>7)=\frac{3}{10}=0.3.\]
The favourable length is \(0.5-(-0.5)=1\). The total length is \(1-(-1)=2\). Therefore \[P(-0.5<X<0.5)=\frac{1}{2}.\]

questions.prompt: A continuous random variable has density \(f(x)=2x\) for \(0<x<1\). Find \(P(0<X<0.5)\).
questions.answer: Integrate the density: \[P(0<X<0.5)=\int_0^{0.5}2x\,dx=x^2\big|_0^{0.5}=0.25.\]

questions.prompt: A continuous random variable has density \(f(x)=\frac{1}{4}\) for \(2<x<6\). Find \(P(3<X<5)\).
questions.answer: This is uniform on \([2,6]\). The interval length is \(2\), and the total length is \(4\), so \[P(3<X<5)=\frac{2}{4}=0.5.\]
For a continuous random variable, a single point has zero width and zero area. Therefore \[P(X=0.4)=0.\]
The favourable interval is \([5,6.5)\), with length \(6.5-5=1.5\). The total length is \(9-5=4\), so \[P(X<6.5)=\frac{1.5}{4}=0.375.\]
The total area under a density must be \(1\). Thus \(c(12-3)=1\), so \(c=1/9\).
The intervals have total length \((2-0)+(6-5)=3\). The total length is \(6\), so \[P(X<2\text{ or }X>5)=\frac{3}{6}=0.5.\]

questions.prompt: A random variable has density \(f(x)=\frac{1}{8}\) for \(4<x<12\). Find \(P(X>10)\).
questions.answer: The favourable interval has length \(12-10=2\). Multiplying by the density gives \[P(X>10)=2\cdot\frac18=\frac14.\]

questions.prompt: A continuous random variable has cumulative distribution function \(F(x)=x^2\) for \(0\le x\le1\). Find \(P(0.3<X<0.8)\).

questions.answer: The condition restricts the interval to \((25,100)\), length \(75\). The favourable part is \((25,40)\), length \(15\). Therefore \[P(X<40\mid X>25)=\frac{15}{75}=0.2.\]
